# AcceptanceContracts.ps1

Defines the shared acceptance contracts used by the producer (`build/Test-Privileged.ps1`), installer/Windows 10 composers, and the final acceptance aggregator. The Windows privileged list is fixed to the sixteen capabilities in `Requirements/25_WINDOWS_PRIVILEGED_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md`; installer case IDs and Windows 10 Stage A check names are also centralized. Consumers reject missing, duplicate, or extra names instead of trusting an evidence artifact's self-declared subset. `Write-NewJsonArtifact` rejects an already-existing destination, serializes evidence to a same-directory, create-new temporary, flushes it, then atomically moves it to the destination without replacement; a concurrent collision or write failure is fail-closed and leaves existing evidence untouched.

This file does not execute tests or mutate host configuration. The artifact writers only create a new evidence file when explicitly called. `Write-NewTextArtifact` and `Write-NewJsonArtifact` share a common publisher that refuses existing outputs, writes a new temporary using `FileMode.CreateNew`, flushes it, then moves without replacement. It is dot-sourced by the acceptance scripts and is covered by PowerShell parser validation, documentation mirror validation, and the installer/acceptance contract tests.
